items.reason: Conditions list grade II/III glioma, but inclusion requires current glioblastoma: "prior histologically-confirmed diagnosis of a grade IV glioblastoma, or ... grade II or III malignant brain tumors and now has radiographic progression consistent with a grade IV glioblastoma". Only glioblastoma is eligible, so gbm_only rather than several glioma types.

note: Moot for inclusion: the only intervention is chlorotoxin CAR T cells (excluded type), so the trial fails S6 whichever population value is used. The conditions field naming grade II/III glioma is why coder B chose mixed; if XL prefers the conditions field, mixed_glioma_gbm_named is also inclusive and changes nothing. MMP2 eligibility (IHC) is an entry requirement but not candidate-matched (no candidate). tumour_pk/target_engagement: CAR T measurements concern the excluded therapy, not a candidate, so 'no' (priority-3 rows, proposed only in proposed_final).
